mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide reduces renal perfusion and glomerular filtration rate, potentially decreasing piperacillin-tazobactam clearance and increasing antibiotic levels; thiazides can also cause hypokalemia which may be compounded by beta-lactam-induced potassium loss.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (particularly potassium), and antibiotic levels; adjust piperacillin-tazobactam dosing if renal impairment develops; ensure adequate hydration.
